# set y value of 12 and comparison to y is equal to 7, y is less than 15, y is greater than 20, y is less than or equal to 12

```{r}
y <- 12

print(y == 7)
```
```{r}
y <- 12

print(y < 15)
```
```{r}
y <- 12

print(y > 20)
```

```{r}
y <- 12

print(y <= 12)
```
